From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 06 May 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: EMEA weekend closure prep — stage triage & finalize flags

Team —

Quick one ahead of the weekend: Finance needs a tight reconciliation of any stage moves that will affect our May close. I pulled the current opportunities flagged as 'Likely' or 'Commit' and there are ~27 accounts with recent stage changes. We need a fast pass to:

- Confirm which deals are true COMMITs (PO/contract in flight or explicit procurement date)
- Flag any deals that should be downgraded to PROSPECT/Risk (no 30–60d certainty)
- Surface any accounts that will push ARR into next fiscal month (for recognition needs)

Action requested: please update your rows in the shared sheet (link below) with a 1-line rationale and expected close date. Target: EOD Friday 07-May 18:00 CET.

Links / files: shared sheet (please do not rename tabs) + I attached a CSV export of the stage changes I used as the source: EMEA_stage_changes_20280506.csv

Priority accounts I already flagged in the sheet: ByteWave, Stellarnet, NimbusCloud. If you own any of these please call out the exact procurement step.

If you hit any blockers (legal/SC/ops) call me or Marissa directly. We will roll final commit flags to Finance at 16:00 UTC on Monday.

Thanks — short and focused.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, EMEA Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: EMEA_stage_changes_20280506.csv (CSV export of last 7 days stage activity)

Thanks Mina — taking inventory now. Quick notes (I'll update the sheet by 1600 CET):

- ByteWave — moving to COMMIT. Procurement has signaled PO expected by Tue next week. Rationale: legal has cleared SOW; customer finance confirmed budget. (see note in sheet).
- NimbusCloud — downshift to PROSPECT. Account requested additional architecture work and timeline slipped >60d.
- Stellarnet — needs confirmation: CSM reports verbal green but no PO yet. I left a note for Carmen to confirm by EOD Fri.

I attached my working CSV with line-level comments: k_iyer_stage_notes_20280506.csv

Will ping offline for any deals where I'm missing ARR numbers.

Karthik
